rationale.hitl-workflow: Bounded delegation requires approval gates and retained human decision authority.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Developers report verification demand rising as AI accelerates code production.
rationale.quality-debt: Survey finds technical-debt and documentation-drift backlogs needing earlier intervention.
rationale.ai-review: Proposed assistants probabilistically judge diffs, designs, security findings, and incidents.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Quality gates combine deterministic analyzers, tests, static checks, and sandboxing.
rationale.risk-routing: Risk radar and backlog prioritizer allocate attention using computed severity signals.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Rationales, provenance, uncertainty, and checked-scope summaries support human judgment.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Authority boundaries require agents halt before out-of-scope changes or decisions.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Compliance compiler maps policies to applicability decisions and auditable evidence.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent decision graphs and evidence ledgers preserve traceability for human audit.
rationale.survey-input: Large developer survey yields substantive AI-support preferences and governance priorities.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes automation-maximalism by preserving human craft, judgment, and accountability.
rationale.design-only: Twenty-two system designs specify capability steps and constraints without implementations.
rationale.general-code: Several proposed review mechanisms target code changes generally, not exclusively AI code.
rationale.agentic: Scoped PRs, patches, plans, and documents are delivered as reviewable artifacts.
rationale.steering: Multiple workbenches shape generation through scoped context, requirements, and inputs.
rationale.risk-security: A pre-merge security advisor contributes contextual vulnerability detection and remediation.
rationale.risk-quality: Proposed gates mitigate regressions, maintainability failures, test gaps, and documentation drift.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Human approval and non-self-certification constraints substantively mitigate over-reliance.
rationale.method-self-report: Evidence comes from open-ended questionnaire responses by 860 developers.
